# `supreme_court_index_observations`

**Retained Supreme Court index renders**

One retained Supreme Court term-index render with complete native index data and separate historical request facts.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected retained term-index renders and PDF probes. Repeated renders, missing links and revisions remain distinct; capture completion, redirects, PDF semantics and wider term coverage require separate evidence. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `supreme_court_index_observations.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader-generated identity of this selected source observation. |
| `observation_key` | `VARCHAR` | Retained render label distinguishing repeated observations at the same term URI. |
| `index_url` | `VARCHAR` | Maintained canonical term-index URI stated by the selected term. |
| `stated_term` | `VARCHAR` | Literal term label retained from the index render. |
| `native_index_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete maintained native index, including every selected render row. |

| `locator_binding` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded basis binding the selected bytes to their declared URI. |

| `pdf_scope` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit selected retained-probe scope, without all-term acquisition inference. |
| `source_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Public URI identifying the selected source bytes. |

| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded acquisition observation time; null when unrecorded. Separate from publication time. |
| `observation_time_state` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit state of the acquisition clock; unrecorded values stay unknown. |
| `term_year` | `BIGINT` | Term year validated against the retained index. |
